description: MCP server for the Spaceship API — manage domains, DNS, contacts & marketplace listings via AI

tool_signatures.name: check_dns_alignment
tool_signatures.description: Compare a list of expected DNS records against the actual records configured in Spaceship. Returns which expected records are missing and which unexpected records exist. Useful for verifying DNS configurations match your infrastructure requirements.

tool_signatures.name: create_a_record
tool_signatures.description: Create an A record (IPv4 address) for a domain.

tool_signatures.name: create_aaaa_record
tool_signatures.description: Create an AAAA record (IPv6 address) for a domain.

tool_signatures.name: create_alias_record
tool_signatures.description: Create an ALIAS record (CNAME flattening at zone apex) for a domain.

tool_signatures.name: create_caa_record
tool_signatures.description: Create a CAA record (Certificate Authority Authorization) for a domain. Controls which CAs can issue certificates.

tool_signatures.name: create_cname_record
tool_signatures.description: Create a CNAME record (canonical name/alias) for a domain.

tool_signatures.name: create_https_record
tool_signatures.description: Create an HTTPS record (SVCB-compatible for HTTPS) for a domain. Used for HTTPS service binding and ECH.

svcPriority.description: Service priority (0 = alias mode, 1+ = service mode)

parameters.name: svcPriority
parameters.description: Service priority (0 = alias mode, 1+ = service mode)

tool_signatures.name: create_mx_record
tool_signatures.description: Create an MX record (mail exchange) for a domain.

tool_signatures.name: create_ns_record
tool_signatures.description: Create an NS record (nameserver delegation) for a domain.

tool_signatures.name: create_ptr_record
tool_signatures.description: Create a PTR record (reverse DNS pointer) for a domain.

tool_signatures.name: create_srv_record
tool_signatures.description: Create an SRV record (service locator) for a domain.

tool_signatures.name: create_svcb_record
tool_signatures.description: Create an SVCB record (general service binding) for a domain.

svcPriority.description: Service priority (0 = alias mode, 1+ = service mode)

parameters.name: svcPriority
parameters.description: Service priority (0 = alias mode, 1+ = service mode)

tool_signatures.name: create_tlsa_record
tool_signatures.description: Create a TLSA record (TLS certificate association / DANE) for a domain.

tool_signatures.name: create_txt_record
tool_signatures.description: Create a TXT record (text data) for a domain. Useful for SPF, DKIM, DMARC, verification, etc.

tool_signatures.name: delete_dns_records
tool_signatures.description: Delete specific DNS records from a domain by name and type. Only records matching both the name AND type will be removed. Other records are not affected.

type.description: Record type (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, SRV, etc.)
Record type (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, SRV, etc.)

tool_signatures.name: get_async_operation
tool_signatures.description: Poll the status of an asynchronous operation by its operation ID.

operationId.description: The operation ID returned by an async operation (register_domain, renew_domain, restore_domain, or transfer_domain)

parameters.name: operationId
parameters.description: The operation ID returned by an async operation (register_domain, renew_domain, restore_domain, or transfer_domain)

tool_signatures.name: get_contact
tool_signatures.description: Retrieve a saved contact profile by its unique identifier.

contactId.description: The unique identifier of the contact to retrieve

parameters.name: contactId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contact to retrieve

tool_signatures.name: get_contact_attributes
tool_signatures.description: Retrieve stored contact attributes for a specific contact (TLD-specific extra fields like tax IDs and company registration numbers).

contactId.description: The unique identifier of the contact to get attributes for. Use get_domain to find the contact ID.

parameters.name: contactId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contact to get attributes for. Use get_domain to find the contact ID.

tool_signatures.name: get_transfer_status
tool_signatures.description: Check the current status of a domain transfer to Spaceship. Use this after initiating a transfer with transfer_domain to monitor its progress.

domain.description: The domain name to check transfer status for

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: The domain name to check transfer status for

tool_signatures.name: list_dns_records
tool_signatures.description: List all DNS records for a domain. Uses pagination and can fetch all pages automatically.

tool_signatures.name: register_domain
tool_signatures.description: Register a new domain name. WARNING: This is a FINANCIAL operation that will charge money to the Spaceship account.

years.description: Number of years to register for (1-10, default 1)

parameters.name: years
parameters.description: Number of years to register for (1-10, default 1)

tool_signatures.name: renew_domain
tool_signatures.description: Renew an existing domain registration. WARNING: This is a FINANCIAL operation that will charge money to the Spaceship account.

years.description: Number of years to renew for (1-10)

parameters.name: years
parameters.description: Number of years to renew for (1-10)

tool_signatures.name: restore_domain
tool_signatures.description: Restore a domain that is in the redemption grace period after expiration or deletion. WARNING: This is a FINANCIAL operation that typically costs significantly more than a standard registration or renewal.

domain.description: The domain name to restore from redemption period

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: The domain name to restore from redemption period

tool_signatures.name: save_contact
tool_signatures.description: Create or update a reusable contact profile. Saved contacts can be referenced when registering domains or updating domain contacts. If a contactId is provided, the existing contact is updated; otherwise a new contact is created.

tool_signatures.name: save_contact_attributes
tool_signatures.description: Save TLD-specific contact attributes required for certain domain registrations.

tool_signatures.name: save_dns_records
tool_signatures.description: Save (upsert) DNS records for a domain using PUT with force overwrite.

tool_signatures.name: set_email_protection
tool_signatures.description: Toggle the contact form display for a domain

contactForm.description: Enable (true) to show a contact form instead of email, or disable (false) to show the email directly

parameters.name: contactForm
parameters.description: Enable (true) to show a contact form instead of email, or disable (false) to show the email directly

tool_signatures.name: set_privacy_level
tool_signatures.description: Set the WHOIS privacy level for a domain.

userConsent.description: Explicit user consent for the privacy change (required by the API). Must be true to proceed.

parameters.name: userConsent
parameters.description: Explicit user consent for the privacy change (required by the API). Must be true to proceed.

tool_signatures.name: transfer_domain
tool_signatures.description: Transfer a domain TO Spaceship from another registrar. WARNING: This is a FINANCIAL operation that will charge money to the Spaceship account (transfers typically include a 1-year renewal).

domain.description: The domain name to transfer to Spaceship

authCode.description: Authorization/EPP code from the current registrar. Required for most TLDs, but some (e.g. .uk) do not need one.

parameters.name: authCode
parameters.description: Authorization/EPP code from the current registrar. Required for most TLDs, but some (e.g. .uk) do not need one.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: The domain name to transfer to Spaceship

tool_signatures.name: update_domain_contacts
tool_signatures.description: Update the contacts (registrant, admin, tech, billing) for a specific domain using contact IDs.

domain.description: The domain name to update contacts for

registrant.description: Registrant contact ID (domain owner). Use save_contact to get an ID. Changing this may trigger an ICANN transfer lock.

attributes.description: Contact attribute IDs for TLD-specific requirements

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Contact attribute IDs for TLD-specific requirements

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: The domain name to update contacts for

parameters.name: registrant
parameters.description: Registrant contact ID (domain owner). Use save_contact to get an ID. Changing this may trigger an ICANN transfer lock.
